newsitem.title: UK: Eletrobras mandates ABN AMRO for bond.
newsitem.headline: Eletrobras mandates ABN AMRO for bond.

text.p: Brazil's Eletrobras (Centrais Eletricas Brasileiras SA) will launch a $200 million 10-year Eurobond this month, bankers said on Thursday. ABN AMRO Hoare Govett has won the mandate to lead manage the transaction, bankers said.
Eletrobras asked for approval for a $400 million bond initially, but bankers said the central bank would only approve $200 million.
Eletrobras last tapped the dollar sector in June last year with a $250 million bond that matures in 2004.
The issue is currently trading at around 190 basis points to the 2001 put versus a 338 b.p. launch spread, dealers said.
The bond pays a coupon of 10.0 percent and was jointly lead managed by ABN AMRO Hoare Govett and Salomon Brothers.
In June, Eletrobras President Firmino Ferreira Sampaio said the company had been authorised for an issue of $200 million and hoped to get approval for a total of $400 million.
Sampaio said the funds raised from the bond would be used to accelerate priority investments in transmission.
